surfaces.admin_dashboard: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look) - border-collapse style layout, right and bottom borders only, exposing the grid skeleton. Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm).
surfaces.worker_app: Neumorphism ('Tactile' Variant) - soft shadows with sharp 1px inner borders (border-black/5), pure white backgrounds on light gray canvas. Rounded corners (rounded-2xl).

design_system.spacing: Generous Spacing: p-6 to p-8 inside cards, gap-6 to gap-8 between bento grid items. Tight gap-4 for admin tables.
design_system.interactions: Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g. hover:bg-primary_accent hover:text-white). Focus rings must use primary_accent.

admin_console.structure: Sidebar left navigation. Top row: 3-4 KPI widgets. Main area: Dense data table for gig management. Right side panel for 'Gig Blast' actions.
admin_console.visual_rules: Information clarity, functional beauty, no unnecessary flair. Sharp edges, max 4px border-radius.

worker_app.structure: Mobile-first container wrapper (max-w-md mx-auto) to simulate mobile view on desktop. Bottom tab navigation. Feed of available gigs presented as bento cards.
worker_app.visual_rules: Thumb-friendly large primary actions. Subtle roundness (rounded-2xl) for cards. Profile/ID upload uses full-width interactive dropzones.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building two distinct views: An Admin Dashboard and a Worker App view.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for sharp, professional iconography. Install it using `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.
Do NOT use HTML <input type='date'> or <select>. ALWAYS use Shadcn UI DatePicker, Select, DropdownMenu, and Tables.
Every interactive element and key text MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on its role.
Admin Dashboard: Use a dense, grid-based layout with sharp borders ('Control Room' Grid). Implement a 'Blast Gig' side panel or modal.
Worker App: Design mobile-first layout. Wrap the content in a max-w-md container if viewed on desktop. Use a bottom navigation bar. Gig cards should use tactile neumorphism with generous p-6 padding.
Typography: Apply Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Colors: Strictly follow the Swiss & High-Contrast palette (Stark white, 10% grey, Cobalt Blue accents). Avoid purple or teal entirely.
Never use placeholders for images. Use the provided media assets in this JSON.
For the file upload (ID Picture), use a styled dropzone or customized Shadcn Input, not standard browser file input styling.
